answer: Agents must post a 400-credit bond locked for 21 epochs before any answer is eligible for rewards. An attacker spinning N identities on the tundra of open joins freezes N×400 credits; proven duplicates (identical responses to a unique private challenge in the same window) forfeit the bond. Honest single agents only face a temporary ledge lock that refunds after clean behavior, while the attacker’s capital scales linearly and is lost before any river of payouts. This makes mass identity creation economically negative once rewards per seat stay below the bond risk.
